title: Grilled Fish Tacos
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Mexican dish featuring grilled fish, crunchy slaw, and a zesty sauce.

ingredients.name: Crunchy Slaw (icy cabbage, crunchy carrots)
ingredients.amount: 1 cup shredded cabbage, 1 cup shredded carrots

ingredients.name: Mexican-Style Slaw Dressing
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, salt & pepper

instructions: 2. Season fish fillets with salt, pepper, and your favorite seasonings.
3. Grill fish for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, prepare the crunchy slaw by mixing together the shredded cabbage and carrots.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together the slaw dressing ingredients.
6. Add the slaw dressing to the crunchy slaw and toss to combine.
7. Warm the burger buns on the grill or in the oven.
8. Assemble the tacos by placing a grilled fish fillet on each bun.
9. Top with crunchy slaw, a dollop of Mexican crema, and a slice of radish (if using).
10. Serve with lime wedges on the side.
